gloss: to paste; to stick on; to attach

definitions.gloss: to paste; to stick on; to attach
definitions.explanation: To affix something to a surface using adhesive, or to paste digital content.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}にポスターを{貼|は}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I stuck a poster on the wall.

examples.japanese: コピーした{文章|ぶんしょう}をメールに{貼|は}り{付|つ}ける。
examples.english: To paste the copied text into an email.

examples.japanese: {切手|きって}を{封筒|ふうとう}に{貼|は}り{付|つ}けてください。
examples.english: Please stick the stamp on the envelope.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{貼|は}り{付|つ}ける → {貼|は}り{付|つ}けない (negative)
・{貼|は}り{付|つ}ける → {貼|は}り{付|つ}けて (te-form)
・{貼|は}り{付|つ}ける → {貼|は}り{付|つ}けた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {貼|は}る (to stick) + {付|つ}ける (to attach)

USAGE:
・シールを{貼|は}り{付|つ}ける (to stick on a sticker)
・{写真|しゃしん}を{貼|は}り{付|つ}ける (to paste a photo)
・リンクを{貼|は}り{付|つ}ける (to paste a link)

In computing contexts, often abbreviated to just {貼|は}る or ペーストする.

KANJI NOTE:
Can also be written as {張|は}り{付|つ}ける, though {貼|は}り{付|つ}ける is more common for sticking/pasting.
